changes.title: rdst: Bill own-key provider cost in hosted inference quotas

rationale.a: Changes Keyservice hosted-inference cost accounting, which runs server-side outside every area.
rationale.b: Hosted inference trial quotas now bill own-key provider cost, changing the usage and remaining credit shown for account AI.

changes.title: rdst: Defer SSH key discovery until SSH is opened

rationale.a: The connection form mounts SSH fields only when the SSH section is expanded, so new macOS users are not prompted for Downloads access on first launch, and the desktop app declares the Downloads usage reason.
rationale.b: The database connection form (shown on first-run onboarding and when editing a database) now mounts its SSH jump-host fields and key discovery only when the SSH section is expanded.

changes.title: rdst: Clean up keyservice CI envs monthly by age

rationale.a: Moves keyservice CI environment cleanup to a monthly scheduled job, which is CI only.
rationale.b: Changes keyservice CI environment cleanup scripts and the Buildkite schedule only.

changes.title: rdst: Isolate desktop flavors and add a staging channel

rationale.a: Desktop flavors now resolve their own deep-link scheme, autostart entry, data directory, keyring service and Docker container names, which change desktop deep links and open-at-login, sidecar start-up state, the stored sign-in session, the demo sandbox containers and the provider OAuth return link.
rationale.b: Gives each desktop flavor its own identity, data dir, URL scheme, autostart entry, update channel, sidecar instance and sign-in return scheme, changing how the packaged shell launches, stores data, deep-links and signs in.

changes.title: rdst: Let release candidates be tried on staging

rationale.a: Adds CI packaging of staging desktop variants and keyservice deploy steps; desktop source changes are comments only.
rationale.b: CI packaging of a staging desktop variant and keyservice deploy gating; the desktop source changes are comments only.

changes.title: rdst: Wait longer for monitoring slot claims

rationale.a: AI monitoring's database slot claims wait up to 20 s for the Key Service, so turning on monitoring for several databases no longer leaves some pending.
rationale.b: Key Service slot claims wait 20 seconds so turning on monitoring for several databases at once no longer marks some pending.

changes.title: rdst: Lead monitoring with actions and an index plan

rationale.a: Monitoring builds an index plan and database checks into actions with I did this / Not now / Dismiss, the Database page gains Actions/Queries/Reports tabs, and Home, Inbox, Connect, the sidebar and Activity rows follow the new layout and new model calls.
rationale.b: Database page now leads with index-plan Actions, Queries and Reports tabs, with new monitoring checks and explanations feeding Home, Inbox and Connect.

changes.title: rdst: Add continuous analysis monitoring

rationale.a: Introduces background monitoring with the Database page, Inbox and Agent activity pages, onboarding straight into monitoring, monitoring and AI key settings, sign-in-gated AI monitoring, home and sidebar changes, demo and Ask edits, and desktop tray, login start, notifications and a supervised backend.
rationale.b: Introduces background continuous monitoring with the Database page timeline and ranked queries, the Inbox, sign-in-first onboarding with monitoring toggles in Settings and Home, AI monitoring requiring sign-in, agent activity, and tray monitoring, login start and uninstall cleanup in the desktop app.

changes.title: rdst: Relay non-prod provider OAuth callbacks through staging

rationale.a: Relays non-production OAuth callbacks through staging inside the keyservice only.
rationale.b: Non-prod environments can now finish the Supabase and DigitalOcean OAuth sign-in used to add a database target; production behavior is unchanged.

changes.title: rdst: Give each keyservice CL a long-lived preview env

rationale.a: Mostly keyservice CI, but CL builds of the app and desktop sidecar now bake in a per-CL or staging keyservice URL, which changes the backend that Readyset sign-in and hosted AI talk to in those builds.
rationale.b: Adds per-CL keyservice preview environments and bakes the keyservice URL into build metadata, which is CI and build tooling.

changes.title: rdst: Run keyservice deploys with wrangler non-interactive

rationale.a: Only makes Keyservice CI deploy scripts non-interactive.
rationale.b: Only sets CI=true in keyservice deploy scripts.

changes.title: rdst: Serve hosted inference from fp8 providers and watch the fleet

rationale.a: Keyservice-only change to hosted inference provider pinning and a provider canary.
rationale.b: Changes which upstream inference providers the server-side keyservice worker pins and adds fleet canary notices, with no app-side behavior change.

changes.title: rdst: Fail the answer when generation output breaks its contract

rationale.a: Ask now reports a failed answer naming the problem when hosted generation output violates its contract, and tolerates unterminated quotes in schema validation.
rationale.b: Ask now reports a hosted-model reply that violates the generation contract (and unterminated-quote SQL) as a normal answer failure instead of an unhandled error.

changes.title: rdst: Send prod and mike keyservice email through Cloudflare

rationale.a: Keyservice email provider configuration only; the keyservice is outside every area.
rationale.b: Keyservice worker email-provider config and README only; the keyservice is not covered by any area.

changes.title: rdst: Serve the keyservice from keyservice.readyset.io over HTTPS only

rationale.a: Points the backend's default keyservice URL at keyservice.readyset.io, which account sign-in, hosted AI and provider OAuth for adding databases all call.
rationale.b: Mostly keyservice hosting and HTTPS hardening, but the client's default keyservice URL moves to keyservice.readyset.io, which account sign-in, trial and hosted AI calls go through.
